notes.title: Next Update: The Emerald City, Main Story & More
notes.content:
🗞️ NEWS – WHAT’S COMING NEXT?
This week I’ve been writing a lot for the main storyline. I’ve shared it with a few people, and they loved it. So I hope it will entertain, move, and inspire you just as much.

Here are a few things I can already reveal:

The story continues from the Purple King’s mission, so you’ll need to work to obtain it. If you already have, destiny will find you.

The heroes will feel the pressure of the world around them. As they grow closer, they’ll have to choose.

I’m going to make you suffer, and I hope also laugh and dream.

Many more adventures are coming, because when this one ends, new paths will open. Remember: this game never truly ends. At least not while I live! It’s the project of my life, and I’m narrating a world where eternal beings dwell. And I’ll take you by the hand into that world—if you wish.

📅 So stay tuned for the next update! I’m working hard on it.
🛠️ OTHER THINGS
The next update will also introduce the foundation of houses, which I’ll refine later. You’ll be able to store your money and belongings at home.

I’ll also add weapons and armor with special powers, like fire resistance and more.

You’ll have to defeat up to 3 bosses, and they’ll be tougher than the Aberration. Watch out!

Many features are in development—both in combat and beyond. Too many to list now. The goal is to expand both depth (features) and breadth (size and locations).
🗺️ THE MAPS DLC NOW HAS A NEW ADVANTAGE
The Maps DLC isn’t required to play. It’s meant as a way to support the development. But now I’ve added a new perk: maps that show exits between areas, and places that require keys or are blocked.

With these new maps, you’ll be able to plan your missions better, and choose your paths more comfortably to reach your goals.
📚 THE BESTIARY
I’ve decided to design it in a style similar to the game, since you’re already familiar with it. It will be an illustrated PDF, with matching background and decorations. It will be a digital DLC.

It will contain a catalog of species, cultures, and peoples of the Rift. Each creature will be described with its traits, strengths, weaknesses, and lore and testimonies.

This DLC will be optional and supportive of the development. I haven’t set the price yet, but it will be moderate and fair.

📄 On my blog, you can view and download a draft page about the dryads and the Gnomurk. 💬 Share your thoughts: Is this the kind of bestiary you want? What’s missing? Dark or light background? Would it be useful in .epub format?

Comment here, on the blog, or in the Community!

✍️ NOVEL
A medium-term project is the novel. Both you, my dear adventurers, and beta readers have told me I must turn it into a book.

So I’m gradually gathering the story, which I’ll expand and unify. I may publish the novel. Most likely, I’ll release it here on Steam, as a support DLC.

But this is a side project. The top priority is the game, then the bestiary. The novel is forming in parallel, since it’s the game’s stories in book format.

📣 Are you excited about the novel? Tell me in the comments! You’ll make me very happy.
🙏 THANK YOU
THANK YOU for playing Caverns and Dryads, adventurer. I hope you enjoy this as much as I do. Stay tuned while I work on this update. I can’t wait to share it with you!

notes.title: 1.3.1 bugfix for map and gold on inventory. Important please update
notes.content:
Hi! I made a fix of some bugs. They are quite important, so please update: (if it's on auto it will auto update when you open Steam.

Version 1.3.1, August 19, 2025
---------------------------
AVOIDING PLAYER STUCK
- Fixes on the map: to avoid having players stuck, I've changed some places that were not working good and had no exits or ways to go back.
- The only places that you can't even approach without keys are now 3: Thornworm Ruins (because it is the barrier against the Paranormal Entities), Palace of the Dryads (because it may be a place to expand the map south), and Emerald City (because it may be a place to expand the map north).
- In the rest, if they need a key, you can approach and then, even if you can't enter because you don't have the key, you will be able to skip it and go to another place.
- Mansion of Dreams now connects to Golden Caverns (and to Thornworm if you have the key)
- Arcanopolis not connected to Mansion of Dreams, because being a city, you could travel between these two and boost your stats without any difficulty and that would otherwise ruin the game balance.
- Arcanopolis now connects to Verdant Grotto only.
PLEASE IF YOU FIND YOURSELF SOMEWHERE THAT YOU CAN'T GET OUT, TELL ME!

- Now you can take gold coins in Loot even if you don't have space in your inventory, as they go to gold and not to the backpack.

notes.title: Update 1.3: Procedural missions!
notes.content:
Hi adventurers!

In this update, 1.3, I've added the engine for procedural quests. They are called "jobs" inside the game.

Basically a NPC approaches you and asks you to do something. They will pay you gold if you accomplish the mission.

If you change your mind and for some reason you don't want to complete the mission, you can quit it. For that, click on the text of the quests briefings, and choose to quit.

Now you will find delivery missions, but I will add more types next. Like defeating special monsters, bosses or sub-bosses, battling witches, rescuing someone, and more.

With these missions you will always have something to do.

In the meantime I will make more deep and hand made chapters and quests, including the main quests and some core secondary ones. But now you don't have to wait to have missions to do!

If you would like some kind of mission to be included, please tell!

So start updating and playing! You will have to save for buying a house and other things. Have fun!


[hr][/hr]
COMPLETE CHANGELOG: Version 1.3, August, 2025

MOST IMPORTANT UPDATES:

Procedural quests, called jobs (trabajos in Spanish, missions in French).

In cities, you may be hired for jobs. Now, the jobs are about delivering documents to some other city, but I will add more job types which will include defeating menacing monsters, witches, rescuing someone or finding someone, and more.

If you finished the Purple King quest to save the river of Drozz, Urvhal V may also hire you, and he will pay 3 times more than other people.

Added chapter to quit a job. You can quit a job just clicking the quests text and choosing to quit or not.

OTHER:

Fixed some bugs and texts.

There's a passage between Verdant Grotto and Arcanopolis now.

Fixed buttons and text delay in Fine and Beggars screens.

Button for spells on map for Android is now active.

Fixed display of spell name when you learn it, for Acid Balll.

notes.title: 1.2 Update: quest of the Purple King!
notes.content:
EXCITING NEWS! ːsteamhappyː

A huge THANK YOU, brave adventurers, for playing Caverns and Dryads and for turning this world of my creation into something alive and truly yours!

You can now update the game to version 1.2. This version brings life to the Caverns and Dryads:

First quest: The Purple King! Heralds of the Purple King will look for you as soon as you finish the place you are now, and will require you to visit his court for a quest!

You will face a mission to save the city of Subterranea and the whole Chasm!

Defeat a very big boss monster! Be careful, keep your potions, prepare to use blade and spells against a monster that can smash an entire army!

We will dive deep into Tamzyn's mind: how she feels, what thoughts put her in a dilemma between her heart and the distance that eternal youth puts to her feelings.

Decide in the story parts: what you decide will mean bigger or lesser rewards. Make the best decisions, and the relationship between the heroes will grow. By the end of this, they may progress from partners to friends.

Get two amazing weapons and a great armor to face the big boss monster, once you visit Urvhal the Purple King.

Get a lot of money if you succeed in the quest. Maybe you can buy a house in the near future with it! ;)

We now have a working story engine with all of this inside story parts: music, sound effects, loot, combat...



From now on, I will be able to add lots of stories: in bars, between places, at the inn... I plan to add a lot for background, for diversity in cities and sanctuaries, conversations between our heroes... And there's also now a quest engine, so I can expand the game with more secondary and main stories and quests for our heroes! ːsteamhappyː



PS: Please provide me with feedback about the difficulty of the quest. It should be not impossible or too hard, but also not easy. It’s okay if you get killed by the boss monster, but not if it kills you every time. Feel free to post in the Community Discussions!



IF YOU ARE CURIOUS, HERE'S THE COMPLETE CHANGELOG:

Change on quest display: you can have a main quest and a secondary quest. You can abandon some secondary ones at any moment (except core stories that need to be done). The main one is tied to the story of the game.

Internal changes on Quests and Chapters to add more features.

Engine for dealing with different kinds of chapters and quests.

Added mechanism for multiple reward/punishment depending on actions chosen in a chapter.

Added mechanism for checking stats, relationship and status from the player to influence the chapters.

Modified the combat mechanism in story chapters to introduce the monster as usual.

Added mechanism to allow for different endings based on combat or other actions being a victory or failure.

Now weapons and armors can be found (and equipped) on loot screens.

Fixed: giving money for guards’ fines in cities didn’t work.

Several bug fixes.

Added possibility of having sound effects inside chapters, in addition to music.

Different combat music for chapters, besides the usual for normal fights, and another track for boss monsters.

Added sound for titan-type boss monsters.

Rebuilt many parts of the chapter engine to add new features and robustness.

Shake effect on boss monster images, fade from red to color on other monsters.

Map now has visual hints that connect some places. Part of the image of a location may resemble another, indicating a possible passage between them. Also look for paths drawn in the picture!

Now if you die and lose money, you won’t always lose all of it, but a random quantity. This way, you can't be so unlucky to lose everything in one mistake.

Fade-in effect on monster screens. Bosses have additional effects too.

There are currently 3 types of chapters: main plot (ordered, main quest), core (secondary plot, ordered, secondary quest), and random (unordered, secondary quests). I still have to implement the third type and how and where it appears so it doesn’t conflict with core ones. Maybe I’ll add ternary quests.

Sioul has become hairy because of plot requirements.

Some dryads have had their images changed or retouched to avoid misunderstandings.

Music added to loot screen.

Some monster descriptions fixed.

Exits from Stone Hell to Stairs of Despair were broken. Fixed those and other nearby blocked exits.

notes.title: Update 1.1.1: Secondary weapons, commerce, and more!
notes.content:
Hi adventurers! Great news! :)

I added a bunch of features to the game! 
You can update now, and enjoy them.
As the list may be boring to read, and it's better to show them,
I encourage you to visit my blog and see:
http://www.beautifulfantasy.art/2025/06/version-111-whats-new-inventory-combat.html

As always, comment on the Discussions here, or on this post, as you wish! I love reading your feedback! :)
The most exciting of all this is that they allow a lot of new things to happen in the game, that I will be developing next! Stay tuned!:) It's exciting to have you on board on this adventure!

--

Here's the list of what's new if yo don't:

Version 1.1.00 - June, 2025
----------------------------
- Now you can BUY AND SELL your loot in the cities' shops!
- New spell on sale on shops of the cities: Acidball!
- New wepon that you can find at cities' shops: ball and chain.
- Now you will be able to buy weapons at shops. No one wants to buy yours, though, because they are used. Maybe at blacksmiths in near future.
- Inventory shows main weapon (equiped) and secondary (not equiped) and you can swap between them clicking on any of them. Also, there's the weapons button to see the main weapon detailed stats.
- You can now swap your weapons in combat and use your inventory in the middle of combat, for drinkingpotions or change your weapon to the one that can harm the monster (or try!)
- Finding a new weapon in the dungeons now lets you choose to swap it with one of your weapons (main or secondary), or just continue walking.
- You can now re-enter the city in which you are in, without having to leave. Money is the only limitation for you there.
- Changed the icon on Windows for settings from a musical note to a cog, that is more conventional.
- Minor bugs.

notes.title: Version 1.0.14 with story engine and inventory
notes.content:
Version 1.0.14 - May, 2025 
--------------------------
- Bug fix: player states like poisoned or paralyzed, etc may be added several times and didn't were removed by the spell cure on one attempt. Now it's fixed and states won't be duplicated.
- Optimization: Added methods to deal with several parameters of the player in a more solid way.
- Created the details of the game that register the relationship between the heroes and their milestones in the game.
- Fixed a typo in French.
- Added description of the relationship of the heroes in the Heart screen.
- Now the game has support for growing the relationship through the stories.
- The inventory of object has been implemented to add support for keys, objects on quests, and other objects. 
- Added an apple as object to the inventory that you carry. Use it to recover 5 life points and use it two times. I will add more objects to the game in different places, but this is just to test.
- On combat, the real life points of monsters are displayed, so when I add the boss monsters you feel more frightened by the difficulty of beating them.
- Added color to the number to guess in doors, so you see more clearly if the max is 10 or 50.
- Added back button in tutorial so you can re-read it easier without going to menu.
- Tutorial stories appear now before you enter some situations for first time (only), like combat and on others. This way you can learn as you play, although the tutorial is recommended too.
- Added functions to the story engine to get armors, keys, weapons, story milestones, and more.
- Added the possibility of confronting a special enemy in the middle of a story.
- Message when game starts that reminds you to play the intro story on the menu.
- Tutorial chapter on the first combat that tells you some strategy.
- Tutorials for magic, cities, sanctuary, and worldmap.

notes.title: The first early release is coming in the next days! What I've added here
notes.content:

Caverns and Dryads will be available for you to download as early release in the next days!

BUT THERE'S MORE! I've implemented the chapters engine. So now I'll populate the game with interactive stories that may reward you with stats raise, gold, spells, keys to places, and more.

So in  the next release, you will have all that and I will also be adding more features easier. It was the piece I was massing to build most of what is left.
Here below there's a devlog entry of what is new in that future release for now.

Note: For many people it will be the first downloaded version for Windows, because I will post it shortly after the game is published in the next days. You can check your version on the top right of the menu screen. After that expect frequent updates!

notes.title: Thank you! What I'm doing now, and new features suggestions
notes.content:
Hi dear adventurers!
This is just a post to quickly tell you:

- Caverns and Dryads is getting wishlists and some people already joined the Hub Community, so I am incredibly happy and grateful for you to come into my world!

- I am now in the thinking phase of the next features of the game. I found that many of them need the story framework (same that the intro story uses) to be developed in more depth. Why? Because it opens the gate to add the boss monsters, keys, inventory, relationship milestones between the protagonists, drama... SO MANY things. All of them need it to some degree. 

- I will start implementing the story framework from simple to complex features, so we see new features soon, and then go adding more complex ones. I think it's the best way for me to do and for you to start enjoying the possibilities it opens.

- Suggest your features in the Discussions of the Hub! Here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/3634870/discussions/

For example: things that you may love to be added to stories so they can happen. But there are several threads open where you can suggest things. In the way I find they fit the game, I will add them at some point.

Remember that there is also an Artwork section where I will post some image, but you can post too, sending images you do of fanart of the game (all arts welcome:  generative / AI / traditional / digital...).

Thanks again for joining! :) Seeing people enjoy this journey fills me with joy and makes me feel very encouraged to give the best of me! :)

- Louis.
